plugins.name: prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: /optimize rewrites a draft prompt with repo context and fills it into the composer

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff summarizes the session into a prompt a fresh session can pick up; --new continues it in a fresh session

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: /brainstorm studies the project and brainstorms ideas in the browser; /brainstorm plan turns picked ideas into a small-step plan; /brainstorm build has small-model subagents implement it and a strong model review it

plugins.name: draft-pr
plugins.description: /draft-pr drafts a pull request in the project's PR template; /draft-pr-review drafts a review as Conventional Comments; each opens an editable page in the browser that posts to GitHub only when you click

plugins.name: adhd-style
plugins.description: ADHD output style: answer first, short chunks, one next step

plugins.name: code-style
plugins.description: Comment and naming rules at session start; hooks block comments, short or vague identifiers, and finishing before a naming review

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Red, green, refactor enforced: the TDD rules at session start; hooks block implementation edits until a failing test run is recorded and block finishing while tests fail

plugins.name: quality-gates
plugins.description: Blocks git commit and push when fallow audit fails, and finishing a turn that changed code without a verification step

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Command guards: denies unbounded git log, diff and find, trims long Bash output, blocks commits that skip hooks or fail the project's checks, limits Reads of large files, and asks for a browser check after UI edits

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: /design new and /design redesign open mockups in the browser, built from the project's own colors, type, spacing and components; /design audit checks the theme and components for hardcoded values and inconsistencies; /design apply builds the picked variant

plugins.name: session-notes
plugins.description: Notes each session's prompts, edited files and commands into the plugin store, never into Claude's context; Claude writes notes with write_note or /note; /notes shows them in a pane
